title: Cabcharge Australia Limited - proposed acquisition of Suburban Transport Services Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Timeline suspended pending receipt of further information from merger parties.
Cabcharge announced it will not be proceeding with the proposed acquisition of Suburban Transport Services. ACCC review discontinued.
